svg.title: From an inner time to a periodic product state
svg.desc: Each matrix probability list is rounded in logarithmic coordinates to one translate of a lattice with spacing two pi over P. A summed square-root overlap estimate gives a unitary change of the full product representation. The local matrix algebras are fixed and the new faithful state has period P. Tensor absorption implies the corresponding inner time, with parameter lambda equal to exp minus two pi over P.

g.text: Realizing an inner modular time P > 0
The exact construction and estimates are proved in MIV Section 21.
q̃ⱼ = pⱼ exp(−ϑⱼ/P), qⱼ = q̃ⱼ / Σ q̃ₖ
The common normalization preserves all ratios.
Control the change of reference vector
V : H_Q → H_D is onto and fixes every local matrix action
V(xΩ_Q) = xΞ. The transported state ψ is faithful and normal, and the modular time map at P is the identity.
Section 22: A ⊗ R_λ ≅ R_λ implies 2π/|log λ| ∈ T(A), 0 < λ < 1.
